provenance.description: Owned editable COMPOSITE height preference controls regenerated in the native reference application. Geometry and displayed fonts come only from native drawing XML, glyph predicates independently measured in the browser. Varies font size, algorithm rulers, frame/container sizes, relative positions, all four LIN directions and multiple text branches. Includes unresolved vertical controls without the container height preference in the strict audit. Parent-height and fixed versus live height/trailing controls distinguish physical text overflow from parent retry demand. Initial container growth controls verify that completed local searches survive preference publication and rebuild at a new parent allocation.
